title: 第七章 幽怀藏情愫 心眷花月仙第八章 花月伴尘途 同心赴劫波

;;
夜笼幽谷，月华铺陈，溪声潺潺，花香绕袖。何年、何月、何日三子盘膝坐于花台之下，闭目凝神，潜心融合《六千字文》与草木花信时序诀，周身时序、月华、日光三气，伴着谷中花草灵机，缓缓流转，氤氲成辉。
花月初归隐四时仙葩，仙葩玉瓣莹润，散出淡淡清辉，笼罩整座幽谷，驱尽夜寒，涤荡心神。谷内天地气机，愈发平和，时序井然，无半分外界纷乱，宛若凡尘桃源，岁月安闲。
何日心性跳脱，却也知此乃修行良机，敛了浮躁，潜心参悟。日神正阳之力与草木柔和之气相融，刚中带柔，烈中含温，褪去往日莽撞，多了几分沉敛。周身金光内敛，不再肆意张扬，只循道韵滋养神魂，稳固道基，不过夜半，便已将草木时序诀熟记于心，与自身神力相融无碍。
何月本就秉性温婉，月华清和与草木灵韵本就同源相契，修行起来事半功倍。她静心体悟花月初所授大道要义，悟得阴阳调和、生灵相护之理，净化戾气、安抚神魂之术愈发精纯，周身银辉温润，慈悲之意更甚，连周遭花草，受其气息滋养，都愈发娇艳欲滴。
何年居于正中，怀捧玉简，指尖轻触百花灵玉，心神沉浸于大道之中，却又难掩一丝波澜。年神主岁月时序，本应心境澄明，无悲无喜，不生杂念，可白日花月初之音容笑貌、温婉气度、慈悲道心，却屡屡浮现在脑海之中，挥之不去。
他自幼执掌年岁时序，居于天界神域，见惯仙神威仪，历千万载岁月，心若古井无波，从未有过半分波澜。自堕凡历劫，与弟妹相依，心怀救世使命，满心皆是修补玉璧、安定苍生，更无儿女情长之念。
可今日一见花月初，那身着粉衣、立于繁花之中的身影，那温润婉转、慈悲平和的言语，那度化魔念、护养生灵的道心，皆如一粒种子，悄然落入他沉寂千万载的心田，悄然生根，泛起微澜。
花月初之姿，清丽绝尘，不似天界仙娥那般雍容威仪，反倒如幽谷清风、花间朝露，纯净温婉，沁人心脾；花月初之道，守一方灵境，护草木生灵，不逐名利，不贪功业，顺天应时，慈悲度世，恰与《六千字文》守心向善、顺时守序之旨，完美契合。
他运时序大道，欲摒除杂念，定心凝神，可每每闭目，皆是女子浅笑嫣然之态；每每参悟经文，耳畔皆萦绕着女子提点道韵之声，心绪难平，灵台微扰。
何年暗自心惊，连忙收敛心神，默念《六千字文》开篇经文，以求定心。“天地初开，时序乃定，心无杂念，大道归真……”朗朗经文在心底流转，可那道花间身影，依旧清晰，挥之不散。
他深知，身为年神，身负救世天命，凡尘历劫，当斩断尘缘，摒除七情六欲，坚守道心，不可滋生儿女私情，乱了心神，误了救世大业。可情之一字，不知所起，一往而深，非是大道可压制，非是神力可斩断，越是刻意压制，心底念想，反倒愈发清晰。
“兄长，你气息紊乱，时序气机微乱，可是修行遇阻，或是经脉不适？”
何月率先察觉何年异状，缓缓睁开双眸，眸中满是关切，柔声开口问道。何日亦随之睁眼，看向兄长，见何年眉头微蹙，气息略有浮沉，也连忙开口：“阿兄，可是大道相融不畅？若是有疑难，我与阿姐可一同参悟，切莫独自强撑。”
何年被弟妹一语惊醒，连忙压下心底纷乱情愫，调匀气息，睁开双眸，眸中波澜渐敛，恢复往日沉稳，轻声言道：“无妨，只是初融草木时序之道，与年岁时序大道相参，一时未能全然贯通，气机略有不顺，现已无碍。”
他言语淡然，不露半分心绪，可唯有自己知晓，方才并非大道不通，乃是心有杂念，情丝暗生，乱了自身时序道心。
何月聪慧，见兄长神色虽平复，却难掩眼底一丝隐晦波澜，心中了然，却也不点破，只是柔声提点：“天地大道，皆由心生，心定则道纯，心乱则道杂。《六千字文》有言，守心即是守道，无论遇何种机缘、何种心绪，皆需守住本心，不扰于外，不乱于心，方能大道顺遂。”
一语点醒梦中人。
何年闻言，心中骤然清明。他执掌时序，知岁月无情，大道无私，儿女私情，于凡俗乃是常情，可于身负天命的历劫之神而言，便是心魔，便是劫数。花月初乃幽谷花灵，守谷不出，他乃历劫神祇，征途不止，本就殊途，更何况浩劫当前，苍生为重，岂能因一己私情，乱了天命，误了苍生？
他缓缓闭目，再运时序大道，观自身心绪，察心底情愫，以岁月沉淀之力，抚平心神波澜，以救世使命，压制私人情愫。

他并非忘却，而是将那一丝初见慕意，悄然藏于心底，化作修行之动力，护道之信念。他暗下决心，待来日修补时序玉璧，平定三界浩劫，还天地安宁，护草木生灵，再念今日之缘，亦不迟。
心绪既定，杂念尽消，何年周身时序之气再度平稳，莹白光芒与草木灵辉相融，愈发醇厚。年岁更迭、草木枯荣、万物生息、时序轮回之理，在心底愈发清晰，两道大道彻底贯通，神念愈发澄澈，道基愈发稳固，封印的神力，再度解封几分。
一夜无言，静心修行。
待到晨曦微露，朝阳东升，金色暖阳穿透幽谷林木，洒落在繁花之上，露珠晶莹，熠熠生辉，花香愈发清冽，谷中生机愈盛。
三子齐齐睁眼，眸中精光内敛，修为皆大有精进。
经一夜修行，三人已然将草木时序诀与《六千字文》彻底融合，彻悟天地完整时序大道，神力复元，道心稳固，精气神俱佳。
何日起身，舒展筋骨，周身金光微漾，意气风发，朗声道：“兄长、阿姐，我已修行圆满，可出山历劫，再荡魔邪！这幽谷虽好，终究不是久留之地，苍生浩劫未解，我等不可久耽于此。”
何月亦起身，轻拂衣衫，月华敛于周身，温婉点头，看向花台之上的四时仙葩，柔声言道：“承蒙花仙子传道赠玉，恩重如山，我等临行之前，当拜别仙子，再启征途。”
何年缓步上前，立于花台之前，望着那株莹白剔透的四时仙葩，心底微起波澜，却转瞬即逝，神色沉稳，躬身行礼，声音清朗，带着一丝不易察觉的郑重：“晚辈何年，携弟妹，承蒙仙子传道授法，馈赠灵玉，庇佑修行，大恩大德，没齿难忘。今我等修为稳固，欲出山继续历劫，特来拜别仙子。”
“此去，我等必坚守本心，循道向善，荡尽魔邪，修补时序玉璧，护三界生灵，护天地草木，定不让仙子苦心白费，不负仙子今日指点之恩。待来日浩劫平定，必再临幽谷，拜谢仙子。”
言语铿锵，心意赤诚，那一丝深藏心底的慕意，皆化作护道救世、守护此谷灵境的决心，融入字字句句之中。
何月、何日亦紧随其后，对着四时仙葩躬身行礼，拜别花月初。
花台之上，四时仙葩光芒微漾，一道淡粉花雾缓缓浮现，化作花月初清丽身影，立于繁花之间，眸光温润，含笑看着三人，柔声言道：“尔等道心坚定，修为精进，实属难得。今既已贯通大道，便安心出山历劫，天地浩劫，苍生为重，切勿辜负自身天命。”
她眸光轻转，淡淡扫过何年，眸中温润，似是看透了他心底潜藏的丝丝情愫，却未曾点破，只是柔声提点：“时序大道，贵在守恒，人心之道，贵在坚守。无论前路遇何种劫数，何种心绪，皆需不忘初心，方得始终。”

In the deep valley at night, the moonlight spreads out, the sound of the stream gurgling, and the fragrance of flowers wraps around the sleeves. The three sons of what year, what month and what day sat cross-legged under the flower bed, closed their eyes and concentrated, concentrating on integrating the "Six Thousand Character Essay" and the timing formula of vegetation and flowers. The three qi of timing, moonlight and sunlight around the body, accompanied by the inspiration of the flowers and plants in the valley, slowly flowed and became dense.
At the beginning of the month, the fairy flower retreats into seclusion. The jade petals of the fairy flower are shiny and moist, emitting a faint light, covering the entire valley, driving away the cold night and refreshing the mind. The atmosphere of heaven and earth in the valley is becoming more and more peaceful, and the time is in order. There is no chaos in the outside world, just like a paradise in the world, and the years are peaceful.
When my mind wanders, I know that this is a good opportunity for practice. I suppress my impetuosity and concentrate on enlightenment. The power of the sun god's positive yang blends with the gentle aura of the vegetation. It is hard yet soft, fierce yet warm. It has faded away from the past recklessness and become a bit more calm. The golden light all over the body is restrained and no longer wantonly displayed. It only nourishes the soul according to the rhythm of the Tao and stabilizes the foundation of the Tao. Before midnight, the timing of vegetation has been memorized in the heart, and it is integrated with its own divine power.
He Yue has a gentle nature, and the beauty of the moon and the aura of the plants and trees have the same origin and are in harmony with each other, so practicing can get twice the result with half the effort. She meditated to comprehend the essence of the Tao taught by Hua Yue, and understood the principles of the harmony of yin and yang and the mutual protection of living beings. The art of purifying the anger and soothing the soul became more and more refined. The silver glow around her body was warm and compassionate, and even the surrounding flowers and plants became more and more delicate and beautiful when nourished by its breath.
He Nian was sitting in the middle, holding a jade slip in his arms, touching the Baihua Lingyu with his fingertips, his mind immersed in the great road, but he could not hide the trace of waves. In the time sequence of the years of the year, the mind should be clear, without sadness or joy, and without distracting thoughts, but the voice, smile, gentle demeanor, and compassionate heart of the day, flowers, and moon come to mind again and again, and they can't go away.
He has been in charge of the order of years since he was a child, living in the realm of heaven and gods, and is accustomed to seeing the majesty of immortals and gods. After thousands of years, his heart is as calm as an ancient well, and there has never been any waves. Since falling into the mortal world, he has been dependent on his younger brothers and sisters, with a mission to save the world. He is only focused on repairing the jade and stabilizing the common people, and he has no thoughts of everlasting love for his children.
But today, when he saw Hua Yue, the figure in pink clothes standing among the flowers, the gentle, compassionate and peaceful words, and the Taoist heart of transforming demonic thoughts and protecting living beings were all like a seed, quietly falling into his heart that had been silent for thousands of years, quietly taking root and causing a slight ripple.
The appearance of the flower at the beginning of the month is pure and beautiful. It is not as graceful and majestic as the fairy in the heaven. Instead, it is like the breeze in the valley or the morning dew among the flowers. It is pure, gentle and refreshing.
He followed the path of time sequence, trying to get rid of distracting thoughts and concentrate his mind, but every time he closed his eyes, the woman smiled sweetly; every time he meditated on the scriptures, his ears were filled with the voice of the woman mentioning some Taoist rhymes. His mind was hard to calm down, and his spiritual platform was slightly disturbed.
He Nian was secretly frightened, so he quickly calmed down and silently recited the opening verse of "The Six Thousand Character Essay" to calm his mind. "The heaven and earth have just opened, the time sequence is determined, there are no distracting thoughts in the mind, and the great road returns to its true state..." The clear text circulates in my heart, but the figure among the flowers is still clear and lingering.
He knew very well that as the god of the year, he had the destiny to save the world. After experiencing calamities in the mortal world, he should cut off the worldly ties, get rid of the seven emotions and six desires, and stick to the Taoist heart. He should not breed personal relationships between his children, mess up his mind, and miss the great cause of saving the world. The word pity is unknown, and it goes deeper and deeper. It cannot be suppressed by the great road, nor can it be cut off by divine power. The more I suppress it deliberately, the thoughts in my heart become clearer.
"Brother, your breath is disordered and your timing is slightly disordered. However, your practice is hindered, or your meridians are uncomfortable?"
He Yue was the first to notice something strange about He Nian. She slowly opened her eyes, her eyes full of concern, and asked softly. He Ri also opened his eyes and looked at his brother. He saw He Nian's brows were slightly furrowed and his breath was a little hesitant. He also quickly said: "Brother, but the Dao is not harmonious? If there are any problems, Sister and I can understand it together."Don't hold on alone. "
He Nian was awakened by his younger brother and sister's words. He quickly suppressed the chaotic emotions in his heart, calmed his breath, opened his eyes, the waves in his eyes gradually subsided, and returned to his former composure, and said softly: "It's okay, it's just the beginning of the time order of vegetation, which is consistent with the order of the years. I couldn't fully understand it for a while, and the Qi movement was slightly irregular, but now it's OK. "
He spoke calmly and did not reveal any of his emotions, but only he knew that it was not that the Tao was blocked, but that he had distracting thoughts and hidden emotions in his heart, which disrupted his own time and Taoist mind.
He Yue was smart and saw that although his brother's expression was calm, he could not hide a vague wave in his eyes. He knew it in his heart, but he did not point it out. He just reminded him softly: "The great roads of heaven and earth are all born from the heart. If the heart is fixed, the Tao will be pure, and if the mind is confused, the Tao will be complicated. "The Six Thousand Character Essay" says that guarding the heart means guarding the Tao. No matter what opportunities or moods you encounter, you must keep your original heart and not be disturbed by the outside world or disturb your heart, so that the Tao can go smoothly. "
A word to wake up the dreamer.
When He Nian heard this, his heart suddenly became clear. He is in charge of the timing, knowing that time is ruthless, the road is selfless, and the personal love of children is normal to the common people, but for the God of Calamity who is responsible for destiny, it is the inner demon and the calamity. At the beginning of the month of the flower, he is the flower spirit of the deep valley, guarding the valley and not coming out. He is the god of calamity, and his journey is endless, and his path is different. What's more, in the current catastrophe, the common people are the most important, how can he mess up the destiny and miss the common people because of his personal affairs?
He slowly closed his eyes, followed the path of time, observed his own mood, and examined the emotions in his heart. He used the power accumulated over the years to calm the waves in his mind, and suppressed his personal emotions with the mission of saving the world.
He did not forget it, but quietly hid that trace of admiration in his heart, turning it into the motivation for practice and the belief to protect the Tao. He secretly made up his mind to repair the Time Sequence Jade in the future, quell the catastrophe in the three realms, restore peace to the world, and protect the vegetation and living creatures. It would not be too late to remember today's fate.
With the mood set and distracting thoughts gone, the Qi of He Nian's whole body became stable again, and the white light blended with the spiritual brilliance of the vegetation, becoming more mellow. The principles of the passage of time, the withering of vegetation, the growth of all things, and the reincarnation of time are becoming clearer in my heart. The two avenues are completely connected, the spiritual thoughts are becoming clearer, the foundation of the path is becoming more stable, and the sealed divine power is once again released a little bit.
A night of silence and meditation.
When the morning light dews, the morning sun rises in the east, and the golden warm sun penetrates the trees in the valley and falls on the flowers. The dewdrops are crystal clear and sparkling, the fragrance of the flowers becomes clearer and clearer, and the valley becomes more vibrant.
The three sons all opened their eyes, their eyes introverted, showing great improvement in their cultivation.
After a night of practice, the three of them have completely integrated the Grass and Tree Timing Technique with the "Six Thousand Character Classic", and have fully realized the complete timing of heaven and earth. Their spiritual power has been restored, their Taoist hearts are stable, and their energy, energy and spirit are both good.
He got up, stretched his muscles and bones, the golden light around his body was slightly radiating, and he said loudly and vigorously: "Brother, sister, I have perfected my practice. I can go out of the mountains to experience tribulations and fight against evil spirits again!" Although this valley is good, it is not a place to stay for a long time. The catastrophe of the people has not yet been solved, so we cannot stay here for a long time. "
He Yue also stood up, flicked her clothes, the moonlight gathered around her body, nodded gently, looked at the four-season fairy flowers on the flower bed, and said softly: "Thanks to the flower fairy for preaching and giving jade, the kindness is as heavy as a mountain. Before we leave, we should bid farewell to the fairy and start our journey again. "
He Nian walked forward slowly, stood in front of the flower stand, and looked at the crystal clear four-season fairy flower. He felt a slight stir in his heart, but it was fleeting. His expression was calm, he bowed and saluted, and his voice was clear and solemn. He said with a trace of solemnity that was not easy to detect: "Junior He Nian, together with my younger brothers and sisters, thanks the fairy to preach and teach, give spiritual jade, protect my practice, and be a great kindness that I will never forget. Now that our cultivation is stable and we want to go out of the mountain to continue experiencing the tribulation, we came here to say goodbye to the fairy. "
"From now on, we will stick to our true intentions, follow the path of good deeds, drive away evil spirits, repair the jade jade of the time sequence, protect the creatures of the three realms, and protect the vegetation of the heaven and earth. We will not let the fairy's painstaking efforts go in vain, and we will live up to the fairy's guidance today. When the catastrophe is over in the future, I will come to the valley again to pay my respects to the fairy. "
The words are sonorous, the heart is sincere, and the trace is deeply hiddenThe admiration in my heart has turned into the determination to protect the road, save the world, and protect the spiritual realm of this valley, and is integrated into every word.
He month and He day also followed closely behind, bowing to the flowers of the four seasons and bidding farewell to the beginning of the month.
On the flower bed, the four-season fairy flowers shimmered with light, and a pale pink flower mist slowly emerged, turning into a beautiful figure at the beginning of the month. Standing among the flowers, with warm eyes, looking at the three people with a smile, he said softly: "It is rare for you to have a firm Taoist heart and diligent cultivation. Now that you have penetrated the great road, you can go out of the mountains with peace of mind. The world is catastrophic, and the common people are the most important. Do not let down your destiny."
She turned her eyes softly and glanced at He Nian. Her eyes were warm, as if she had seen through the hidden emotions in his heart, but she did not point out the hidden feelings in his heart. She just reminded him softly: "The most important thing about time is preservation, and the most important thing about people's hearts is perseverance. No matter what kind of disaster or mood you encounter on the road ahead, you must not forget your original intention in order to achieve success."
